A_acceptance.evidence: The runner is configured for headed manual member sign-in and organization selection. It matches the web session email fingerprint to the extension Account email, verifies the extension profile id and a successful canonical admin.admins query returning zero rows for that id, and selects the organization through the membership-backed picker. The D61/D62/D63/D67/D68 procedures exercise UI recovery and persistence/deletion. No member native run was executed in this lane, and the governing defect records still say member unverified; no acceptance PASS is established.
cannot_verify: Actual signed-in member behavior and live recovery/persistence/deletion on the imported artifact remain pending the exclusive guarded native run.

The run establishes organization membership through the picker, not the organization's IAM role; that is sufficient for non-extension-admin coverage, but it cannot support an organization-role=member claim.

B_quality.evidence: Source review found the requested identity, artifact provenance, organization choice, scoped workbench.notes fault injection, exact created-note ID capture, reload persistence check, and owned-ID cleanup safeguards represented in the runner. The artifact verifier checks the imported tree and associated CI/local receipts before and after the run. D68 observes a successful live delete response and verifies the owned note is absent after reload. No product source changed in the reviewed commit.

findings.finding: D62 injects a failed POST before the server can commit it. This reproduces the recorded failed-create defect, but it does not exercise an ambiguous commit where the insert succeeds and the response is lost.
findings.evidence: The readiness report discloses this at limits[2]. In armNotesTransport, mode=fail_post uses Fetch.failRequest before forwarding the request; the subsequent retry must produce one response UUID before the runner proceeds.
findings.action: Keep the D62 acceptance claim scoped to a failed preflight POST. Add a separate ambiguous-commit case only if that behavior is a required acceptance target.

limits: Source review only: no tests, browser, build, or authenticated run was launched in this lane.
The source review does not replace the exclusive native acceptance run.
